twoFactorPolicy.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorPolicy.description: Require every member to protect their account with an authenticator app.
twoFactorPolicy.require: Require two-factor authentication for all members
twoFactorPolicy.enabled: Members without two-factor authentication must set it up before reaching the workspace.
twoFactorPolicy.disabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required.
twoFactorPolicy.missingTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Every member has turned it on} one {# member has not turned it on} other {# members have not turned it on}}
twoFactorPolicy.allEnrolled: Nobody is waiting to set it up.

sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let members sign in through your identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace…). People with an email on your verified domain are sent to it and join this workspace on their first sign-in.
sso.domainHint: Members whose email ends with this domain (or one of its subdomains) sign in through this provider.
sso.secretKept: Leave blank to keep the current secret
sso.redirectUri: Redirect URI to register at your provider
sso.dnsInstructions: Prove you own this domain: add the TXT record below at your DNS provider, then select Verify. Until the domain is verified, nobody is routed to your provider.
sso.domainVerified: Domain verified. Members on it now sign in through your provider.
sso.tokenIssued: A new verification value was issued.
sso.enforceHint: Password and social sign-in stop working for everyone on the verified domain. Owners keep their password and two-factor authentication as a fallback if the provider is down.
sso.removeDescription: Members will sign in with their password again, and single sign-on stops being required.

exportDescription: Download a ZIP archive of everything in this organization: projects, tasks, messages, calendars, clients and employee records, members and files. It is prepared in the background and stays available for {days} days.
exportRequested: Export requested. We will email you when it is ready.
